assertions.notes: Recommends `form.WithAccessible(true).Run()` and describes the sequential prompts it presents (numbered choices, y/n, retry on validation errors).
Calls for `--accessible`/`--no-tui`, an environment variable, and a persistent setting, and explicitly says not to rely on detecting NVDA.
Says full-screen redraws, moving highlights, and spinner frames produce noisy or incomplete NVDA announcements, which is why sequential prompts work better.
States that Bubble Tea and Bubbles have no equivalent accessibility mode, so authentication, progress, errors, and completion must also be linear.
